notes: Source read in full: bill-text/119-HR-695.txt (Public Law 119-43) plus both registered referencedSources (usc-38-1562, usc-38-5503). Every figure ($1,406.73, $90, section 1114(m)/(p), section 1562, section 5503(d)(7)), date (November 30, 2031 -> January 31, 2033; Dec 1 2025; Feb 26 / Nov 7 2025), direction (increase/extend/bar-stacking), and entity (Medal of Honor Roll, veteran without dependents, veteran/surviving spouse with no child, Medicaid nursing facility) verifies verbatim against source. No direction inversions, no fabricated accounts, no attribution swaps (the $90 cap is correctly bound to the 5503(d)(2) Medicaid 'after the month of admission' rule, not the (a)(1) three-month rule; 'without dependents' vs 'no spouse nor child' kept distinct). Coverage pass: all operative provisions (short title, findings, Sec. 3 rate change, Sec. 3 no-stacking COLA rule, Sec. 4 sunset extension) are reported -- no material omissions. Only non-SUPPORTED rows are two minor items in likelihoodReason (sponsor name, cosponsor count) that are Congress.gov structural metadata absent from the bill source; neither is material. featured_quotes are Congressional-Record content not present in the provided bill/ref source and were not claim-decomposed (outside the fields in scope).
